user.title: Claude Usage
user.description: Paste the Cookie header from a claude.ai usage request. Open claude.ai in your browser, go to Settings > Usage, press F12, open the Network tab, reload the page, click the request named `usage`, then copy the whole Cookie header value (it starts with `sessionKey=`). Your organization is detected automatically.

data_description.cookie: Treat this like a password. It is stored in Home Assistant's config entry storage.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll claude.ai. 300 to 900 seconds is sensible; the usage counters are coarse.

pick_org.title: Choose an organization
pick_org.description: This cookie can see more than one organization. Pick the one whose usage you want to track.

manual_org.title: Enter your organization ID
manual_org.description: Automatic detection did not work. Find the ID in the usage request URL: `https://claude.ai/api/organizations/<this part>/usage`.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh your Claude cookie
reauth_confirm.description: The cookie for {org} is no longer accepted. Grab a fresh one from claude.ai and paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: That cookie was rejected. Make sure you copied the whole Cookie header, including `sessionKey=`.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach claude.ai. Check Home Assistant's internet access and try again.
error.challenge: claude.ai returned a bot challenge page instead of data. Try copying the Cookie header again, including the `cf_clearance` value if present.
error.unknown_response: claude.ai answered, but not with usage data this integration recognises. The endpoint may have changed.

abort.already_configured: This Claude organization is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Cookie updated. Usage tracking has resumed.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll claude.ai, in seconds. Polling faster than every 5 minutes gains you very little and increases the chance of being rate limited.
